messages:
Priya S: Heads-up 3 Cloudway asked for a compact technical playbook, SSO checklist, and an explicit list of outbound IPs before the Wed demo. Can someone volunteer to own the playbook?
Alex M: I got this. Will make a 1-page playbook + a short runbook for infra. Do we have their SP metadata?
Priya S: Yes 3 Ben sent SP metadata this morning, I pasted it into the shared doc. They also want cert rotation window and TLS cipher policy.
Alex M: Cert rotation = 90 days by default. TLS policy: TLS1.2+ with AEAD ciphers. I'll add a one-line summary and link to the full security page.
Alex M: Quick infra suggestion for their infra team to prepare (so they can pre-provision firewall rules):
```yaml
redwood_connection:
  mode: dedicated
  outbound_ips:
    - 35.203.45.10
    - 35.203.45.11
  tls_rotation: 90d
```
Dan R: @Sam (security) they included a security questionnaire asking about KMS, data residency, audit logs, and retention. Can you own answers?
Sam (security): Will do. We support customer-managed KMS for Private, HSM on-prem. Hosted uses envelope encryption; legal needs to review customer-KMS addendum. SOC2 and pen test report links are in the compliance drive.
Mia K: Pricing Q: Cloudway wants a blended pilot rate for 3 months. They estimate avg QPS ~30, bursts to 200 for short spikes. Any suggestion for pilot pricing structure?
Dan R: For pilots we usually suggest reserved pilot capacity + burst credits. Proposal: base commit = 2x avg sustained = 60 QPS, include 5k burst credits for spikes, 25-30% pilot discount for first quarter. I'll build the numbers and loop in finance.
Priya S: Partner also asked about automatic model degrade when capacity is hit (to keep latency stable). Is that doable?
Alex M: Yes 3 runtime supports smart routing/fallback by model. Example routing policy snippet to show them: 
```json
{"routes":[{"preferred":"rw-large-v1","fallback":"rw-medium-v1","max_latency_ms":1000}]}
```
Dan R: Timeline: demo Wed AM. Deliverables due Tue EOD: playbook + SAML finalization + pricing doc. Owners?
Alex M: Playbook/runbook = me. Will post draft link here.
Dan R: Pricing = me; sending draft to finance ops (cc Kevin).
Sam (security): Questionnaire + artifacts = me. Note: partner asked for SIEM log retention 18 months; we ship 12 months standard, 18 via enterprise add-on. Flagging legal/CS.
Priya S: Blockers to escalate: (1) partner confirm SAML metadata, (2) finance sign-off on pilot pricing, (3) final outbound IP list. Please call out if anything slips.
Alex M: Draft playbook uploaded: https://redwood.app/drive/playbook-cloudway (please review the SSO section).
Dan R: Pricing draft sent to finance. Will update here after feedback.
Sam (security): Questionnaire answers uploaded; linked SOC2 and pen-test. Legal to follow up on retention/KMS terms.
Mia K: I'll schedule partner enablement for Thurs 10am PT (45m). Will send invite once finish details.
Priya S: Quick check-in tomorrow 11am PT to confirm everything. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
